db:info.db:title: DependentValueProbe Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <typename T, T N> class DependentValueProbe

db:abstract.db:para: A dependent non-type parameter renaming probe.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: The T parameter is a type and N is a value of that type.

db:section.db:title: [noexcept] void dependentValueCheck(DependentValueProbe<T, N> &a, T value)
db:section.db:para: Required dependent-value-renaming marker. Checks a and value.
